rules: Every button label starts with a verb, is in sentence case and is 24 characters or fewer.
Headlines start with the hazard, are 40 characters or fewer when {when} is filled in, contain no digits with % and no jargon.
Errors are full sentences that end with a period, neutral in tone and say what to do next.
Jargon (CAPE, lifted index) appears only under why.technical*, never in the main view.
Never write an official-sounding warning: only NWS text is shown as a warning, and it is labelled National Weather Service.
_meta.pluralisation: Use files.one for a count of 1 and files.other otherwise.
